snippet.title: Cursed Moon ~The Girl Trapped in the Haunted House~｜Trailer
snippet.description:
After hearing a young girl's cry for help, Yukine as a kami went in to the unknowned dimension to help. While helping the ghosts on the way to fulfill their wishes, she also has to solve riddles and traps. Will Yukine be able to save the girl from this cursed dimension ......?

Developer: つっきーのお茶会
